:::{#sol-euclidean-distance}

1. $$
   \begin{aligned}
   \vx - \vy &= (1 - 4, 2 - 6) \\
   &= (-3, -4).
   \end{aligned}
   $$

2. $$
   \begin{aligned}
   \norm{\vx - \vy} &= \sqrt{(-3)^2 + (-4)^2} \\
   &= \sqrt{25} \\
   &= 5.
   \end{aligned}
   $$

3. $\vy - \vx = (3, 4)$,
   and

   $$
   \begin{aligned}
   \norm{\vy - \vx} &= \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} \\
   &= 5.
   \end{aligned}
   $$

   Yes, the result is the same.

:::
